title: A Soccer Game at the Park
body: On Saturday afternoon, Mia and her brother Leo joined a soccer game at the park. Their friends were already on the field, so they quickly put on their shoes. Mia played near the goal because she was good at stopping the ball. At first, Leo ran too fast and missed several passes from his friends. Mia told him to slow down and watch the other players. A few minutes later, Leo passed the ball to a girl in a yellow shirt. She kicked it into the goal, and everyone on their team cheered. After the game, they sat under a tree and shared some cold water. Leo was tired, but he wanted to play again next Saturday.

questions.prompt: ミアとレオはどこでサッカーの試合に参加しましたか。
ミアがゴールの近くでプレーしたのはなぜですか。
choices: 走るのが苦手だったから
ボールを止めるのが得意だったから
シュートの練習をしたかったから
questions.answer: ボールを止めるのが得意だったから

questions.prompt: 試合のあと、みんなは何をしましたか。
choices: すぐに次の試合を始めた
